oneLine: Suntory Holdings in discussions to acquire a 10-15% promoter stake in Allied Blenders & Distillers.
seller: Promoters of Allied Blenders and Distillers

sources.title: Eye on India cocktail, Suntory eyes 10-15% stake in Allied Blenders & Distillers
Allied Blenders In Talks For Up To 15% Stake Buy By Suntory

synopsis: Suntory Holdings is in early discussions to acquire a 10-15% promoter stake in Allied Blenders and Distillers through a largely primary transaction to form a strategic partnership in India's whisky market. Allied Blenders is controlled by promoter Kishore Chhabria and is India's third-largest listed spirits maker. Separately, promoter Bina Kishore Chhabria sold a 1.96% stake in the spirits maker for Rs 357.6 crore through an open-market transaction, reducing her holding to 56.24%. Allied Blenders declined to comment on market rumours, and Suntory Holdings did not comment.
